description: FlagStat helps flag football programs get clear answers about scoring, stats, reports, rulesets, and season operations. Coaches, athletic directors, league organizers, and scorekeepers can use it to understand live scoring, film review workflows, exports, compliance needs, and program setup inside ChatGPT.
